title: Chapter 356
text:
Everyone looked at each other with a surprised expression on their faces.

Gashley shook his head helplessly. Black Star's choice of words was more polite, so he was not angry at being rejected. He only felt regret.

Although Sky Ring was a large organization, most of its members did not feel arrogant because of this. Sky Ring was a proper mercenary organization that belonged to the lawful faction. They would not make enemies easily.

Gashley felt that it was a pity. At this time, Han Xiao suddenly changed the topic and asked, "Black Star Mercenary has only been established for a month. Sky Ring is interested in us because we have the legendary ability to revive, right?"

Gashley did not hide it. He nodded and said, "Yes."

Han Xiao smiled and said, "Although I don't want to join other mercenary organizations, I think we can reach another cooperation model. Sky Ring is such a big business, and there must be many dangerous missions. My team can accept the indirect employment of Sky Ring and replace the dangerous missions that can easily lose people."

Gashley's eyes flickered. Even if he could not recruit Black Star, it was not bad to reach a cooperation.

The Sky Ring Army had similar cooperation relationships with other mercenary groups. This was also Sky Ring's connections in the industry. There was a long list of these partners, which was equivalent to Sky Ring's support. If they were in danger, they could ask these reliable partners for help at any time.

The two discussed for a while and reached an agreement. Then, Gashley reported to the organization.

Many mercenary groups wanted to contact a large organization like Sky Ring, and people often applied for cooperation. The people of Sky Ring were already used to it. Most of the applicants did not meet the requirements, but Black Star was approved directly due to the special characteristics of his revival ability. His name was added to the cooperation list, and Han Xiao signed a cooperation contract.

The general meaning of the contract was that all members of Sky Ring could contact Black Star privately and ask for support at any time, but they had to pay separately. The contract stipulated that both parties were partners and could not start a war in any form. If Sky Ring was hired by one party, Black Star could not be hired by the other party, and vice versa. Otherwise, it would be considered a breach of the contract, and the first party to breach the contract would have to pay compensation, and the contract would be voided. Other than that, the other terms were very loose.

Han Xiao was quite satisfied with the result. It was equivalent to gaining a new client. He could use Sky Ring's reputation to expand his business. Sky Ring definitely did not lack battle opportunities, so his mercenary group would not lack work opportunities either. After all, the mercenary group had just started, and they could earn money no matter who hired them.

While they could not enjoy the privileges of Tian Huan, at least they had an additional background that was beneficial to the development of the mercenary group.

After signing the contract, Han Xiao suddenly thought of something and said, "If I'm not wrong, you guys will be recruited by the Silvers."

Gashley nodded. "It's not just Sky Ring. The other large mercenary groups will not give up on this opportunity. My team has received a call from the officers, and we will depart to Fawn Galaxy to meet up later."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. "Can my team follow you? If you get a mission, you might need our help. I'm happy to be hired by Sky Ring."

Gashley paused for a moment and thought about it. There did not seem to be any harm in bringing a group of Immortal Mercenaries, so he said, "Okay, you can bring your team to the dock later and take our spaceship to move together. However, you have to be mentally prepared. If the mission is very simple, Sky Ring will not need our help, and you will have come for nothing."

Han Xiao waved his hand, indicating that it was fine.

He felt that this was a pleasant surprise. Using Sky Ring's relationship, he could skip the credit point requirement. Although the mercenary group was still very weak and did not have much chance to gain the favor of the Silvers, he could count on Sky Ring to hire him again.

The three types of knowledge of compression technology were his goal. Sky Ring had many experts, so they would not lack the advanced knowledge. If he was lucky enough to be hired, he felt that he could try to raise the conditions.

…

After finalizing the time and dock number, Han Xiao returned to the stronghold and gathered all the members.

"We have a new job. Get ready, we will depart soon," Han Xiao said with his arms akimbo.

Everyone was overjoyed and excited. Knowing that the mercenary group had the potential to grow, the players had been looking forward to the next adventure. After being idle for so long, there was finally work.

Maple Moon raised her hand and asked, "What are we doing this time? Why didn't the mercenary group's information show a new hiring mission? "

"Recently, the Silvers have received quite a lot of attention. We will follow the people of Sky Ring to the Fawn Star System. I have formed a partnership with them, so we might get hired." Han Xiao thought about it and added, "Also, don't raise your hand next time you ask questions."

No wonder the interface did not trigger a mission. Everyone understood. They followed Han Xiao's lead and had no objections to the arrangement.

Herlous was very surprised. He knew how powerful Sky Ring was. It had only been a few hours since they last met, so how did Han Xiao form a partnership with Sky Ring? There was no sign at all.

Herlous pulled Han Xiao aside in private and expressed his doubts. Han Xiao did not hide anything and told him the whole process.

"I see." Herlous was impressed. If he were the one negotiating, he probably would not have thought of proposing a partnership and would have lost this opportunity. Although in his eyes, Han Xiao was not strong enough, his ability to make use of every opportunity was amazing. Such a person was more suitable to be the captain.

"Then, did you foresee anything?" Herlous whispered.

Han Xiao shook his head helplessly. He really did not this time.

The Silvers were not a storyline he was familiar with, so he did not have any impression of it. It should not be anything big …

…

The Sky Ring Army was huge, so Gashley's team had an internal spaceship. It was a civil spaceship that was dozens of meters long, narrow at the front and wide at the back. It was streamlined and looked like a water droplet, but it had sharp edges. The exterior armor was covered with sections of dark gold metal structure, like the gaps in the armor. On the left and right sides of the rear of the spaceship were mechanical bars that were slanted to the body of the spaceship. At the end of the bars were helical propellers. There were a total of four propellers that could change angles and were more flexible. This was a spaceship from a civilization in the Gelock Star Cluster. It was equipped with a Light Hyperdrive Engine, good at galactic travel, but slightly weak in combat.

This kind of small spaceship was much cooler than the large spaceships of the Galactic Travel Agency. The players sized it up with admiration.

Han Xiao touched his chin. He also wanted to buy an exclusive spaceship for his mercenary group, but it was too expensive. Even the simplest single-person galactic spaceship cost more than 100,000 Enas. If he wanted to save money, he could only build it himself. However, building a galactic spaceship was too difficult. Engine, energy, armor adaptability, structure strength, probes, and so on required a lot of knowledge. He was far from being able to do it now.

When it was time to meet up, the Sky Ring mercenaries arrived, and the group walked onto the spaceship. Gashley set the automatic route on the control panel. The spaceship left the dock and entered the outer vacuum with a shake.

The rear thrusters emitted a golden light, and the spaceship gradually entered the hyperdrive state. The bright galaxy outside the window quickly blurred and finally turned into a pulling glowing line that seemed to have an infinite length. It rushed into a teleportation stargate near Juberly Hub.

"We can reach the Fawn Star System very quickly through the stargate. The Silvers' spaceship is stationed on Planet 12 in Star Zone 4. The journey will take about twelve days," Gashley said to the group.

There were more than eighty people on the spaceship, so there was quite a lot of space. After the players allocated their rooms, they showed their initiative. They went to chat with the Sky Ring mercenaries.

Han Xiao went to find Gashley. The two of them had just met today, so they mainly talked about the mission. However, Gashley did not know the specific details. He only knew that he was only one of the teams that had been summoned. The representative of Sky Ring this time was a Three-Ring officer with the code name [Ice Arcanist].

A Three-Ring officer was the backbone of the organization. They were basically all strong combatants with the strength of Grade B. This Ice Arcanist was the leader of Sky Ring this time and had the authority to decide whether to hire Han Xiao or not. This code name sounded like a Mage.

Han Xiao had not come into contact with the Mage class yet. The Mage class was a class that was as difficult as the Mechanic class. Furthermore, the enchantment ability could also strengthen mechanical equipment. Unfortunately, the Blue Star players only had Pugilist, Esper, and Mechanic classes.

After chatting for a while, Gashley went back to his room to rest. Han Xiao then visited the spaceship by himself. He came to the living area of the spaceship and realized that there was a combat simulation room installed on the spaceship. It used virtual imaging technology to fool the senses of the user and simulated all kinds of enemies and environments to achieve the effect of combat training.

Han Xiao operated the display and showed the scene inside. Herlous was waving the Battleship Slicing Blade and fighting with an endless stream of strange beasts. The silver-white flames were splashing everywhere like waves.
